name: docu-me-mermaid-toolchain
description: Not a JS project: this manifest exists only to pin the beautiful-mermaid version that templates/tools/render-mermaid.mjs is written against, and to install it so the renderer's end-to-end tests can run (they skip with a reason when node_modules is absent). Run 'npm ci' before 'dotnet test' to exercise them. DocuMe itself ships as a .NET tool; consumer repos install this dependency themselves.
